articles.title_en: Racial and Ethnic Representation in Local Government
articles.title_cn: 地方政府中的种族与民族代表性
articles.abstract_en: Does the presence of underrepresented racial/ethnic groups in a legislative body differentially impact outcomes for members of those groups? We study close elections between White and non-White candidates for California city council and the corresponding impact on housing values, a summary statistic for neighborhood investment. We find electing non-White rather than White candidates generates differential home value gains in majority non-White neighborhoods. This result, which is not explained by correlations between candidate race and political affiliation or neighborhood racial composition and income, suggests that increased representation can reduce racial disparities. Our results strengthen with increased city-level segregation and council member pivotality. (JEL D72, J15, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 立法机构中代表性不足的种族/民族群体的存在是否会对这些群体成员的结果产生不同影响？我们研究了加州城市议会白人与非白人候选人之间的势均力敌的选举，以及其对住房价值（社区投资的汇总统计量）的相应影响。我们发现，选举非白人而非白人候选人会在多数非白人社区产生不同的房屋价值收益。这一结果无法用候选人种族与政治派别或社区种族构成与收入之间的相关性来解释，表明增加代表性可以减少种族差异。我们的结果随着城市层面的隔离程度和议会成员的关键性增强而更加显著。（JEL D72, J15, R23）

articles.title_en: The Returns to STEM Programs for Less-Prepared Students
articles.title_cn: STEM项目对准备不足学生的回报
articles.abstract_en: The returns to selective STEM programs depend on whether students complete these programs, earnings conditional on completion, and counterfactual schooling choices. Much research has focused on only one of these margins, potentially leading to an incomplete picture of the returns to STEM education for students with less academic preparation. Using data from a Colombian university and two empirical strategies, we find less-prepared students have higher earnings returns to selective STEM programs than more-prepared students, even though they are less likely to complete these programs. A key mechanism is that less-prepared students have lower-paying counterfactual schooling options. (JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, O15)
articles.abstract_cn: 选择性STEM项目的回报取决于学生是否完成这些项目、完成条件下的收入以及反事实的 schooling 选择。许多研究仅关注这些边际中的一个，可能导致对学术准备不足学生STEM教育回报的不完整认识。利用哥伦比亚一所大学的数据和两种实证策略，我们发现准备不足的学生从选择性STEM项目中获得的收入回报高于准备更充分的学生，尽管他们完成这些项目的可能性较低。一个关键机制是，准备不足的学生拥有收入更低的反事实 schooling 选择。(JEL I23, I26, J24, J31, O15)

articles.title_en: The Returns to Public Library Investment
articles.title_cn: 公共图书馆投资的回报
articles.abstract_en: Local governments spend over $12 billion annually funding the operation of 15,427 public libraries in the United States, yet we know little about their effects. We use data describing the near universe of public libraries to show that public library capital investment increases library visits, children’s attendance at library events, and children’s circulation by an average of 5–15 percent in the years following investment. Increases in library use translate into improved test scores in nearby school districts: a $200 or greater per student capital investment in local public libraries increases reading test scores by 0. 01–0.04 standard deviations in subsequent years. (JEL G31, H75, I21, L86)
articles.abstract_cn: 地方政府每年花费超过12十亿美元资助美国15,427公共图书馆的运营，但我们对其影响知之甚少。我们使用描述公共图书馆近期情况的数据表明，公共图书馆资本投资在投资后的几年内使图书馆访问量、儿童参加图书馆活动和儿童流通量平均增加 5-15%。图书馆使用率的增加转化为附近学区考试成绩的提高：对当地公共图书馆的每位学生资本投资 200 美元或更多，阅读考试成绩将提高 0。随后几年的01-0.04标准差。 (JEL G31、H75、I21、L86)

articles.title_en: Do Family Policies Reduce Gender Inequality? Evidence from 60 Years of Policy Experimentation
articles.title_cn: 家庭政策能否减少性别不平等？来自60年政策实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Do family policies reduce gender inequality in the labor market? We contribute to this debate by investigating the joint impact of parental leave and childcare, using administrative data covering Austrian workers over more than half a century. We start by quasi-experimentally identifying the causal effects of all family policy reforms since the 1950s on the full dynamics of male and female earnings. We then map these causal estimates into a decomposition framework to compute counterfactual gender inequality series. Our results show that the enormous expansions of parental leave and childcare have had virtually no impact on gender convergence. (JEL D63, J13, J16, J31, J32)
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭政策能否减少劳动力市场中的性别不平等？我们通过研究育儿假和儿童照护的联合影响来为这一争论做出贡献，使用的是覆盖半个多世纪奥地利工人的行政数据。我们首先通过准实验方法识别自1950年以来所有家庭政策改革对男性和女性收入完整动态的因果效应。然后，我们将这些因果估计映射到一个分解框架中，以计算反事实的性别不平等序列。我们的结果表明，育儿假和儿童照护的大幅扩展对性别趋同几乎没有影响。（JEL D63, J13, J16, J31, J32）

articles.title_en: Hospital Queues, Patient Health, and Labor Supply
articles.title_cn: 医院排队、患者健康与劳动力供给
articles.abstract_en: Long waits for health care raise concerns about the consequences of delayed treatment. We use variation in queue congestion to estimate effects of wait time for orthopedic surgery. We do not find that longer wait times lead to increased health care utilization. However, we do find persistent reductions in labor supply: long waits increase medium to long-term work absences and permanent disability receipt. Effects are driven by individuals who are on sick leave at referral. Our results are consistent with patterns of state dependence, where extended periods of temporary disability while awaiting treatment create persistent barriers to returning to work. (JEL I11, I12, I18, J22)
articles.abstract_cn: 医疗保健的长时间等待引发了对延迟治疗后果的担忧。我们利用排队拥堵的变化来估计骨科手术等待时间的影响。我们没有发现更长的等待时间会导致医疗保健利用增加。然而，我们确实观察到劳动力供给的持续减少：长时间等待增加了中长期工作缺勤和永久性残疾津贴的领取。这些影响由转诊时正在休病假的个体驱动。我们的结果与状态依赖的模式一致，即等待治疗期间长期处于临时残疾状态，造成了重返工作的持续障碍。（JEL I11, I12, I18, J22）

articles.title_en: The Gender Application Gap: Do Men and Women Apply for the Same Jobs?
articles.title_cn: 性别申请差距：男性和女性会申请相同的工作吗？
articles.abstract_en: Men and women tend to hold different jobs. Are these differences present already in the types of jobs men and women apply for? Using administrative data on job applications made by the universe of Danish unemployment insurance recipients, we provide evidence on gender differences in applied-for jobs for the broader labor market. Across a range of job characteristics, we find large gender gaps in the share of applications going to different job types even among observationally similar men and women. In a standard decomposition, gender differences in applications can explain more than 70 percent of the residual gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J64, J65, J71)
articles.abstract_cn: 男性和女性往往从事不同的工作。这些差异是否已经存在于男性和女性申请的工作类型中？利用丹麦失业保险金领取者全体的求职申请行政数据，我们提供了更广泛劳动力市场中申请工作性别差异的证据。在一系列工作特征中，我们发现即使在可观测特征相似的男性和女性之间，申请不同类型工作的比例也存在巨大的性别差距。在标准分解中，申请中的性别差异可以解释剩余性别工资差距的70%以上。（JEL J16, J31, J64, J65, J71）

articles.title_en: Killing Prescriptions Softly: Low Emission Zones and Child Health from Birth to School
articles.title_cn: 温和地扼杀处方：低排放区与从出生到入学的儿童健康
articles.abstract_en: We examine the persistence of the impact of early-life exposure to air pollution on children’s health from birth to school enrollment using administrative public health insurance records covering one-third of all children in Germany. For identification, we exploit air quality improvements caused by Low Emission Zones, a policy imposing driving restrictions on emission-intensive vehicles. Our results indicate that children exposed to cleaner air in utero and their first year of life require less medication for at least five years. The initially latent health response materializes only gradually, leaving important but subtle health benefits undetected in common measures of infant health. (JEL I12, I13, J13, Q51, Q53, R48)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用覆盖德国所有儿童三分之一的行政公共健康保险记录，考察了生命早期暴露于空气污染对儿童从出生到入学健康影响的持续性。为识别因果效应，我们利用了低排放区（一项对高排放车辆实施驾驶限制的政策）带来的空气质量改善。我们的结果表明，在子宫内和出生后第一年暴露于更清洁空气的儿童，至少五年内需要更少的药物。最初潜在的健康反应仅逐渐显现，留下了重要但细微的健康益处，而这些在常见的婴儿健康指标中未被检测到。(JEL I12, I13, J13, Q51, Q53, R48)

articles.title_en: Opposing Firm-Level Responses to the China Shock: Output Competition versus Input Supply
articles.title_cn: 企业层面应对中国冲击的对立反应：产出竞争与投入供给
articles.abstract_en: We decompose the “China shock” into two components that induce different adjustments for firms exposed to Chinese exports: an output shock affecting firms selling goods that compete with similar imported Chinese goods, and an input supply shock affecting firms using inputs similar to the imported Chinese goods. Combining French accounting, customs, and patent information at the firm level, we show that the output shock is detrimental to firms’ sales, employment, and innovation. Moreover, this negative impact is concentrated in low-productivity firms. On the other hand, the impact of the input supply shock is reversed. (JEL D22, D24, F14, J23, L25, O31, O34)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将“中国冲击”分解为两个组成部分，它们对面临中国出口的企业引发不同的调整：一个产出冲击影响销售与进口中国相似商品竞争的企业，以及一个投入供给冲击影响使用与进口中国商品相似投入的企业。结合企业层面的法国会计、海关和专利信息，我们表明产出冲击对企业的销售、就业和创新不利。此外，这种负面影响集中在低生产率企业中。另一方面，投入供给冲击的影响则是相反的。（JEL D22, D24, F14, J23, L25, O31, O34）

articles.title_en: Time Aggregation in Health Insurance Deductibles
articles.title_cn: 健康保险免赔额中的时间聚合
articles.abstract_en: Health insurance plans increasingly pay for expenses only beyond a large annual deductible. This paper explores the implications of deductibles that reset over shorter timespans. We develop a model of insurance demand between two actuarially equivalent deductible policies in which one deductible is larger and resets annually and the other deductible is smaller and resets biannually. Our model incorporates borrowing constraints, moral hazard, midyear contract switching, and delayable care. Calibrations using claims data show that the liquidity benefits of resetting deductibles can generate welfare gains of 3–10 percent of premium costs, particularly for individuals with borrowing constraints. (JEL D15, D82, G22, G51, G52, I13)
articles.abstract_cn: 健康保险计划越来越多地仅支付超出大额年度免赔额的费用。本文探讨了在较短时间跨度内重置的免赔额的影响。我们建立了一个保险需求模型，比较两种精算等价的免赔额政策：一种免赔额较大且每年重置，另一种免赔额较小且每半年重置。我们的模型包含了借贷约束、道德风险、年中合同转换和可延迟护理。使用索赔数据的校准表明，重置免赔额的流动性收益可以产生相当于保费成本3-10%的福利收益，特别是对于有借贷约束的个人。(JEL D15, D82, G22, G51, G52, I13)

articles.title_en: Efficiency and Incidence of Taxation with Free Entry and Love-of-Variety Preferences
articles.title_cn: 自由进入与品种偏好下的税收效率与归宿
articles.abstract_en: We develop a theory of commodity taxation featuring imperfect competition along with love-of-variety preferences and endogenous firm entry and exit. We derive new formulas for the efficiency and pass-through of specific and ad valorem taxes. These formulas unify existing canonical ones and feature a new term capturing the effect of variety on consumer surplus. As a proof of concept, we use theoretical formulas to identify love-of-variety preferences in an empirical application. Our welfare analysis shows that the marginal excess burden is sensitive to the estimated love of variety, which overturns classical results on the desirability of ad valorem versus specific taxation. (JEL D11, D21, D91, H25)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个商品税理论，该理论包含不完全竞争、品种偏好以及内生企业进入与退出。我们推导了从量税和从价税的效率与转嫁的新公式。这些公式统一了现有的经典公式，并引入了一个捕捉品种对消费者剩余影响的新项。作为概念验证，我们使用理论公式在一个实证应用中识别品种偏好。我们的福利分析表明，边际超额负担对估计的品种偏好程度敏感，这推翻了关于从价税与从量税可取性的经典结论。(JEL D11, D21, D91, H25)

articles.title_en: Migrants at Sea: Unintended Consequences of Search and Rescue Operations
articles.title_cn: 海上的移民：搜救行动的意外后果
articles.abstract_en: Many countries are facing and resisting strong migratory pressure, fueling irregular migration. In response to mounting deaths in the Central Mediterranean, European nations intensified rescue operations in 2013. We develop a model of irregular migration to identify the effects of these operations. We find that smugglers responded by sending boats in adverse weather and utilizing flimsy rafts, thus inducing more crossings in dangerous conditions and ultimately offsetting intended safety benefits due to moral hazard. Despite the increased risk, these operations likely increased aggregate migrant welfare; nevertheless, a more successful policy should instead restrict supply of rafts and expand legal alternatives. (JEL D82, J15, J18, K37, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家正面临并抵制强大的移民压力，这助长了非正规移民。为应对中地中海死亡人数的上升，欧洲国家在2013年加强了救援行动。我们建立了一个非正规移民模型，以识别这些行动的影响。我们发现，走私者通过让船只在不适宜的天气条件下出发并使用简陋的筏子来应对，从而在危险条件下引发了更多的越境，最终因道德风险抵消了预期的安全效益。尽管风险增加，这些行动可能提高了移民的整体福利；然而，更成功的政策应转而限制筏子的供应并扩大合法替代方案。(JEL D82, J15, J18, K37, K42)

articles.title_cn: 公共养老金与私人储蓄
articles.abstract_en: How does the provision of public pension benefits impact private savings? We answer this question in the context of a Danish reform that increased social security eligibility ages. Using administrative data and a regression discontinuity design, we identify the causal effects of the policy on savings throughout the financial portfolio. We find increases in contributions to personal and employer-sponsored retirement accounts when delayed benefit eligibility induces extended employment. We argue that inertia—the continuation of previous savings behaviors—is a key mechanism, and we highlight how firm default contribution rate policies can mediate savings responses to social security reform. (JEL G51, H55, J22, J26, J32)
articles.abstract_cn: 公共养老金福利的提供如何影响私人储蓄？我们在丹麦一项提高社会保障资格年龄的改革背景下回答这一问题。利用行政数据和断点回归设计，我们识别了该政策对整个金融投资组合中储蓄的因果效应。我们发现，当延迟福利资格导致就业延长时，个人和雇主资助的退休账户缴款会增加。我们认为惯性——即先前储蓄行为的延续——是一个关键机制，并强调公司默认缴款率政策如何能够调节储蓄对社会保障改革的反应。（JEL G51, H55, J22, J26, J32）

articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the effects of Denmark’s Start Aid welfare reform that targets refugees. Implemented in 2002, it enables us to study not only the reform’s immediate effects but also its longer-term consequences and its repeal a decade later. The reform-induced large transfer cuts led to an increase in employment rates, but only in the short run. Overall, the reform increased poverty rates and led to a rise in subsistence crime. Moreover, local demand conditions generate substantial heterogeneity in the reform’s effects on immediate and longer-term employment. (JEL I32, I38, J15, J22, J64, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了丹麦针对难民的“启动援助”福利改革的影响。该改革于2002年实施，使我们不仅能够研究改革的即时效应，还能研究其长期后果以及十年后的废除情况。改革引起的大幅转移支付削减导致就业率上升，但仅在短期内如此。总体而言，改革提高了贫困率，并导致生存型犯罪增加。此外，地方需求条件在改革对即时和长期就业的影响中产生了显著的异质性。（JEL I32, I38, J15, J22, J64, K42）

articles.title_en: Saving Lives with Indexed Disaster Funds: Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 利用指数化灾害基金拯救生命：来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: Developing economies are not disproportionately exposed to natural disasters, but they experience significantly more deaths. Exploiting a discontinuity in the eligibility rules for Mexico’s indexed disaster fund (Fonden), I show that the accelerated reconstruction of public infrastructure can significantly mitigate the mortality impacts of disasters. Fonden’s impact is concentrated in areas with medical infrastructure and among conditions responsive to basic and freely available medical care. These findings suggest that Fonden operates by restoring access to health services. I also show that Fonden is cost-effective relative to other interventions and that its benefit–cost ratio is at least 3.2. (JEL D61, H12, H54, H84, I18, O13, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中经济体并非不成比例地暴露于自然灾害，但它们经历的死亡人数显著更多。利用墨西哥指数化灾害基金（Fonden）资格规则中的不连续性，我表明公共基础设施的加速重建可以显著减轻灾害的死亡率影响。Fonden的影响集中在拥有医疗基础设施的地区，以及对基本且免费可得的医疗服务有反应的病症中。这些发现表明，Fonden通过恢复医疗服务的获取来发挥作用。我还表明，相对于其他干预措施，Fonden具有成本效益，其效益-成本比至少为3.2。（JEL D61, H12, H54, H84, I18, O13, Q54）

articles.title_en: Understanding the Link between Temperature and Crime
articles.title_cn: 理解温度与犯罪之间的联系
articles.abstract_en: The correlation between hot weather and crime is well documented but not fully understood. We combine millions of administrative records, victimization surveys on unreported crime, and daily weather information to analyze the effect of temperatures on crime in Mexico. We find that sample selection cannot explain the observed positive correlation between temperature and crime. Moreover, we find that shifts in alcohol consumption and time use on weekends are responsible for 28 percent of temperature-induced crimes. We also observe changes in the hour and location of crimes, providing new evidence on the importance of time use as a determinant of crime. (JEL D91, K42, O13, O17, Q54)
articles.abstract_cn: 炎热天气与犯罪之间的相关性已有充分记录，但尚未完全理解。我们结合了数百万条行政记录、关于未报告犯罪的受害者调查以及每日天气信息，来分析温度对墨西哥犯罪的影响。我们发现样本选择无法解释观察到的温度与犯罪之间的正相关关系。此外，我们发现周末饮酒消费和时间使用的变化导致了28%的温度诱发犯罪。我们还观察到犯罪发生时间和地点的变化，为时间使用作为犯罪决定因素的重要性提供了新证据。(JEL D91, K42, O13, O17, Q54)

articles.title_en: The Indirect Fiscal Benefits of Low-Skilled Immigration
articles.title_cn: 低技能移民的间接财政收益
articles.abstract_en: Low-skilled immigrants indirectly affect public finances through their effect on resident wages and labor supply. We operationalize this indirect fiscal effect in a model of immigration and the labor market. We derive closed-form expressions for this effect in terms of estimable statistics. An empirical quantification for the United States reveals an indirect fiscal benefit for one average low-skilled immigrant of roughly $750 annually. The indirect fiscal benefit may outweigh the negative direct fiscal effect that has previously been documented. This challenges the perception of low-skilled immigration as a fiscal burden. (JEL H24, H75, J15, J24, J61, J82)
articles.abstract_cn: 低技能移民通过影响居民工资和劳动力供给，间接影响公共财政。我们在一个移民与劳动力市场模型中操作化了这一间接财政效应。我们推导出了该效应以可估计统计量表示的闭式表达式。对美国的实证量化显示，平均每位低技能移民每年的间接财政收益约为750美元。间接财政收益可能超过先前记录的负面直接财政效应。这对低技能移民作为财政负担的看法提出了挑战。（JEL H24, H75, J15, J24, J61, J82）
